## PACE and evidence

- [ ] Problem/constraints remain verified and anonymized
- [ ] Architecture/decisions remain sanitized
- [ ] Contribution/delivery claim is accurate
- [ ] Evidence/outcomes map to an approved private record
- [ ] Manual verification is recorded where required

## Risk and publication

- [ ] Security/privacy impact reviewed
- [ ] No confidential source, raw evidence, client identity or commercial detail
- [ ] No unsupported profitability/live-readiness claim
- [ ] Publication, correction or withdrawal impact described
- [ ] Documentation/runbook/manifest updated

## Handover

- [ ] Public validation passes
- [ ] Reviewer can reproduce the result
- [ ] Ownership, retention and disclosure classification remain accurate
